name: OZONE GENERATOR
desc:
Ozone Generator – Om Jyoti Engineering Enterprises

An Ozone Generator from Om Jyoti Engineering Enterprises is an advanced, eco-friendly disinfection and oxidation system designed for water treatment, air purification, and industrial sanitation applications. It utilizes cutting-edge technology to generate ozone (O₃), one of the most powerful natural oxidizing agents, ensuring superior purification without the use of harmful chemicals.

 What is an Ozone Generator?

An ozone generator is a device that converts oxygen (O₂) into ozone (O₃) using high-voltage electrical discharge or UV technology. The generated ozone is then injected into water or air to eliminate contaminants, micro organisms, and odors effectively.

 Working Principle

The system operates on the principle of Corona Discharge Technology:

Oxygen/air is passed through an ozone chamber
High-voltage current splits oxygen molecules
Free oxygen atoms recombine to form ozone (O₃)
Ozone is injected into water via diffusers or venturi systems
It reacts with pollutants and microbes, oxidizing and destroying them

Ozone naturally decomposes back into oxygen, leaving no harmful residue.

 Key Features:
High ozone output with stable performance
Advanced PLC-based control system (optional)
Stainless steel / corrosion-resistant construction
Energy-efficient operation with low maintenance
Continuous duty (24×7 industrial operation)
Compact, skid-mounted or modular design

 Applications

Ozone generators are widely used across industries:

Water Treatment
Mineral water & packaged drinking water plants
Effluent Treatment Plants (ETP) & Sewage Treatment Plants (STP)
Removal of bacteria, viruses, and organic contaminants
Deodorization and color removal
Industrial Applications
Food & beverage processing
Pharmaceutical water disinfection
Cooling towers and swimming pools
Chemical oxidation processes
Air & Surface Disinfection
Odor removal

Ozone is highly effective in destroying microorganisms and oxidizing pollutants, making it ideal for drinking water and wastewater treatment systems.

 Advantages
Powerful Disinfection: Kills bacteria, viruses, fungi rapidly
Chemical-Free: Eliminates need for chlorine and other chemicals
Eco-Friendly: Converts back to oxygen after use
Improves Water Quality: Removes taste, odor, and color
Cost-Effective: Reduces chemical and operational costs

Ozone is significantly stronger than conventional disinfectants and works faster in microbial elimination.

name: Jockey Pumps
desc:
A jockey pump is a small, low-capacity, high-pressure pump used in a fire protection system to maintain the water pressure in the piping (fire mains). It is an essential component designed to prevent the main fire pump from starting unnecessarily.

Om Jyoti Engineering Enterprises, which likely deals with industrial systems or mechanical engineering, the technical role of a jockey pump can be defined as follows:

1. Primary Function
In a fire sprinkler or hydrant system, pressure can drop slightly over time due to small leaks or changes in temperature. The jockey pump senses this minor drop and turns on to restore the required pressure. This ensures that the main fire pump only activates during an actual fire or a major pressure drop.

2. Technical Specifications
Capacity (Flow): They have a very low flow rate, typically only 1\% to 3\% of the main fire pump's capacity.
Pressure: The pressure rating is usually slightly higher than that of the main fire pump to ensure the system stays pressurized above the main pump's start point.
Pump Type: Most commonly Multistage Vertical Centrifugal Pumps, as they are efficient at maintaining high pressure with low water volume.

3. Key Components
The Pump: Small electric motor-driven pump.
Controller: An automated panel that monitors system pressure via a pressure switch.
Check Valve: Prevents backflow from the main system into the pump.

Om Jyoti Engineering Enterprises is a trusted name in providing high-quality Fire Pump Systems designed for reliable and efficient fire protection. Our fire pumps are engineered to deliver consistent high-pressure water supply for firefighting applications such as hydrants, sprinkler systems, and hose reels.

We offer a complete range of fire pump solutions including electric fire pumps, diesel engine-driven pumps, and jockey pumps, ensuring optimal performance and system pressure at all times. Our products are manufactured using robust materials and advanced technology, complying with industry safety standards.

With a focus on quality, durability, and timely service, Om Jyoti Engineering Enterprises provides end-to-end solutions—from supply and installation to maintenance support—catering to industries, commercial buildings, and residential projects.

name: Mineral Water Plant
desc:
A Mineral Water Plant Setup is a complete system designed to purify and package safe drinking water using advanced technologies like RO, UV, and ozonation. It removes impurities, bacteria, and harmful chemicals while maintaining essential minerals for better taste and health.

The setup includes filtration units, RO system, sterilization, mineral dosing, and automatic filling and packaging machines. Suitable for small to large-scale production, it ensures high efficiency, low maintenance, and compliance with BIS and FSSAI standards—making it ideal for starting a bottled water business.
